collection_formula_audit.assessment: Book superscription governs the purpose prologue through 1:7; it does not erase the parental-discourse opening at 1:8.
Explicit superscription governs 10:1-22:16. Hebrew parallelism and catchwords do not yield sufficiently stable internal macro-boundaries, so the exact collection parent is retained.
Imperative address to hear the words of the wise opens 22:17-24:22 and differs in discourse profile from the preceding Solomonic collection.
'Also these are sayings of the wise' opens a distinct short collection through the field-of-the-sluggard observation at 24:34.
Explicit copying superscription governs 25:1-29:27. Internal court, fool and social clusters remain plausible but disputed; the exact parent is retained.
Agur superscription has severe name, addressee and translation pressure; it opens 30:1-33 without deciding authorship or a preferred parsing.
Lemuel superscription opens the maternal royal instruction at 31:1-9; the alphabetic poem begins a formally different unit at 31:10.

hebrew_textual_observations_evidence_onl: OSHB and UXLC are correlated WLC-family witnesses, not independent votes. Their accents, paragraph marks, morphology, lemmas and qere/ketiv annotations are evidence only.

Qere/ketiv and anomalous-form evidence occurs throughout Proverbs, including the opening discourses and aphoristic collections. It lowers confidence where wording or agreement affects a proposed seam but never selects a reading.
The semantic ranges of mashal, hokmah, musar, binah, torah, yir'at YHWH, zarah and nokriyyah cannot be imported wholesale from roots or lexicons.
Antithetic, synonymous and synthetic parallelism often defines a bicolon but does not by itself create a collection-level chunk boundary.
WEB coordinates are retained for exact coverage. LXX ordering, plus/minus material and local differences are variant evidence only and do not authorize rewriting the Hebrew collection sequence.

Prov.30.1 and Prov.31.1 have names, syntax and translation pressure. Prov.31.10-31 has an alphabetic Hebrew sequence that strongly supports one poem but does not authorize a gender, social, ethical or theological ruling.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: superscription and purpose prologue
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The mashal superscription and purpose infinitives culminate in the fear/knowledge-folly thesis at 1:7; the parental vocative begins at 1:8.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Hebrew construct chains and purpose infinitives bind 1:1-6, while 1:7 functions as a closing programmatic aphorism; neither roots nor the lemma yir'ah decides theology.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Form and syntax support a prologue boundary only; they do not settle authorship, chronology, doctrine or a preferred translation.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: parental instruction against a violent gain-seeking group
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The 'my son' vocative, prohibition, quoted invitation, counter-command and concluding way/greed summary form one instruction before Wisdom's public cry.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Imperatives, conditional enticement and repeated blood/ambush/gain vocabulary bind the unit; Hebrew nephesh wording is translation-pressured and not isolated.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The warning is the speaker's discourse, not authorization of a systematic ethical or historical reconstruction.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: personified Wisdom's public summons, refusal indictment and consequence speech
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Plural public-location imagery and Wisdom's first-person cry open a new speaker-form; the secure-dwelling promise closes before a fresh conditional parental instruction.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Feminine hokmot/personification, repeated call/refuse verbs and the turn from address to consequence bind the speech, but gender grammar does not decide ontology.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No ontological, Christological, source-critical or preferred-reading conclusion is drawn from personification.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: single conditional parental discourse on seeking wisdom, protection and deliverance
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The opening 'my son, if' protasis controls the pursuit sequence; then/for result clauses move through two deliverances and conclude with land-way contrasts.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Hebrew conditional and purpose/result syntax favors one complete discourse; parallel deliverance clauses are internal movements, and zarah/nokriyyah remain semantically disputed.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No gender, covenant, land-tenure, sexual-ethics or textual-preference ruling is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: parental instruction on teaching, trust, honor and discipline
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The parental vocative and alternating imperatives/motive clauses continue through the discipline beatitude; a wisdom beatitude resets at 3:13.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Repeated second-person prohibitions and motive/result bicola bind the instruction; musar and divine-name clauses are not semantic or theological boundary authority.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The unit does not settle prosperity, discipline, causality or theology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: wisdom beatitude and creation-value hymn
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Happy-is formula opens a third-person praise catalogue; comparative value and creation imagery close before 'my son' resumes.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Anaphoric value comparisons and wisdom/understanding terms bind 3:13-20, with a shift from possessor benefits to creation; Hebrew imagery does not establish ontology.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Creation and tree-of-life language remain literary evidence, not doctrinal or intertextual authority.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: parental instruction on preserving wisdom and neighbor conduct
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A renewed 'my son' imperative opens preservation/security counsel and continues into a prohibition catalogue, ending with the wise/fool honor contrast.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Second-person address binds both protection and neighbor prohibitions; the internal social shift is real but lacks a new superscription or speaker.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Hebrew forms do not authorize a comprehensive social ethic or preferred qere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: multigenerational parental appeal and wisdom encomium
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Plural 'sons, hear' and the father's remembered instruction govern an acquisition/exaltation sequence ending in crown imagery.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: The remembered father/son frame and clustered acquire/do-not-forsake/exalt verbs bind the unit; grammatical feminine does not decide Wisdom's identity.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No genealogy, authorship, ontology or reception conclusion is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: parental way instruction contrasting righteous and wicked paths
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A fresh singular 'hear, my son' opens path guidance; paired way imagery culminates in light/darkness contrast before another 'my son' appeal.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Derekh/orah repetition, prohibitions and the paired light/dark comparison support a complete contrast unit.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Path metaphors and moral labels are discourse evidence, not a systematic soteriological or ethical ruling.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: body-part guarded-heart instruction
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The renewed vocative governs ear, eyes, heart, mouth and feet imperatives, closing with the no-turning path command.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Imperatives and coordinated body-part lexemes form a deliberate catalogue; leb is not reduced to one English faculty.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Body metaphors do not authorize anthropology or isolate a famous verse from its instruction.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: parental warning against the foreign woman and call to marital fidelity
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The vocative and attention imperative introduce one warning, consequence appeal, cistern/water counter-image and final way/accountability close.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Second-person address, lips/path imagery and water imagery bind a complete instruction; zarah/nokriyyah and bodily euphemisms are translation-pressured.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No ethnic identification, gender verdict, sexual ethic system or preferred lexical ruling is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: surety entanglement warning and urgent release instruction
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A fresh 'my son, if' condition identifies verbal entrapment; repeated rescue imperatives culminate in gazelle/bird escape images.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Conditional syntax, repeated hand/mouth/snare vocabulary and urgent imperatives make a compact complete admonition.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The unit does not settle ancient legal history or modern financial ethics.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: ant observation and sluggard warning
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The go-to-the-ant imperative begins an observational comparison; the repeated little-sleep refrain and armed-poverty consequence close it.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Imperative, rhetorical questions and the sleep-folding refrain bind the unit; creature vocabulary is not scientific identification authority.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No zoological, socioeconomic or moral-essentialist conclusion is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: worthless-person body catalogue and six-seven abomination saying
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A body-part catalogue portrays the troublemaker; sudden calamity leads into a formally numbered six/seven list whose final discord item echoes the portrait.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Body lexemes and sowing-discord catchword link portrait and numerical list, though the six/seven formula is a genuine internal movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The lexical links do not authorize demonology, total character judgment or arithmetic harmonization.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: parental command-preservation and adultery consequence instruction
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The renewed parental vocative and bind/lead/guard sequence introduce a warning that proceeds through fire/body/legal-social consequences to the jealous-husband close.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Second-person instruction and protection-from-woman purpose clause govern the full warning; compressed comparisons and legal terms remain translation-pressured.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No gender, legal, sexual-ethics or violence authorization follows from the chunk.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: parental instruction with observed seduction scene and closing warning
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The 'my son' charge opens preservation counsel; a window-observation narrative embeds dialogue and pursuit, then plural 'sons' closes with a summary warning.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Opening and closing address frames enclose the narrated example; verbal forms shift for embedded action without requiring a separate parent chunk.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No ethnic, gender, historical, sexual or afterlife ruling is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Wisdom's public self-presentation, value appeal, primordial discourse and final beatitude
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The opening rhetorical call and public-location address establish Wisdom's uninterrupted first-person speech through value claims, primordial language and the hear/blessed/life-death close.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: First-person feminine discourse, repeated wisdom/value lexemes and closing hear-me exhortation bind the speech; Prov.8.22 and related syntax are heavily translation- and reception-pressured.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No preferred translation of qanah, ontology, Christology, creation chronology or source theory is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Wisdom's house, feast preparation and invitation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wisdom builds, prepares and sends maidens; the quoted invitation ends with a life/understanding-way imperative before an addressee/proverb-form shift.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Feminine singular actions and the repeated invitation formula form one scene; the seven pillars remain imagery rather than architectural or symbolic proof.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No allegorical, sacramental, ontological or historical identification is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: interposed instruction on scoffer, wise person and fear of YHWH
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Second-person admonition and antithetic response aphorisms interrupt the two banquet scenes; the responsibility contrast at 9:12 closes before Folly is introduced.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Imperatives and wise/scoffer antitheses bind the interlude, but exact speaker attribution is unstated and remains deferred.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Speaker uncertainty is preserved; no theology of retribution or individualism is decided.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Woman Folly's seated call, invitation and deathward narrator close
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A new feminine figure is introduced and seated at public locations; her invitation echoes Wisdom's, while the narrator's dead/Sheol disclosure closes the diptych.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Feminine participles and echoing invitation syntax contrast 9:1-6; the final third-person disclosure marks closure without defining an ontology.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No misogynistic, ontological, sexual or afterlife ruling is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: first explicitly superscribed Solomonic proverb collection
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The 10:1 superscription opens a long aphoristic corpus; the next explicit discourse formula at 22:17 supplies the reliable outer close. Internal parallelism and catchword chains are too locally variable to authorize stable macro-seams.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: chapter-sized units; couplet-by-couplet chunks; tentative clusters 10:1-15:33 + 16:1-22:16; exact larger parent 10:1-22:16 retained
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: The superscription is explicit, while antithetic, synonymous and synthetic bicola plus recurring catchwords create overlapping networks rather than one demonstrable internal macro-division.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The named collection does not settle individual authorship, collection history, chronology, ethics, theology or preferred readings.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: words-of-the-wise instruction collection

proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Second-person imperatives, motive clauses and the opening words-of-wise formula distinguish the collection from 10:1-22:16; possible external parallels are not boundary authority.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No dependency, dating, authorship, social-policy or theological claim is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: additional sayings of the wise ending in field-of-sluggard observation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The 'also these are for the wise' formula opens the collection; judicial/social sayings culminate in an eyewitness field/vineyard reflection and repeated poverty refrain.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: The superscription supplies the outer seam; first-person observation and the little-sleep refrain form a strong internal close but remain within the short collection.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hezekiah-era copied Solomonic proverb collection
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The explicit copying superscription at 25:1 governs the collection until the Agur superscription at 30:1. Court, fool, conflict and social-justice clusters overlap without a single stable Hebrew macro-boundary.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: chapter-sized 25-29 units; tentative court/fool/social clusters; exact larger parent 25:1-29:27 retained
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: The superscription is direct evidence of received collection framing; accents, parallelism and catchwords support many local pairs but not authoritative chapter or topic seams.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No historicity, precise dating, royal ideology, authorship, textual preference or political theology is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Agur superscription, epistemic confession and paired petition
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The difficult superscription opens a first-person confession/question sequence; the two-things request and poverty/wealth rationale close before a new singular prohibition.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Names/addressee parsing and accents in 30:1 are contested; first-person speech and the two-things numerical request bind 30:1-9 without selecting a superscription translation.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No preferred parsing, authorship, Trinitarian/Christological reading, textual emendation or theology is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: compact prohibition against slandering a servant to a master
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A singular negative imperative plus consequence clause forms a complete admonition between the petition and repeated-generation catalogue.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: attach to 30:1-30:9; attach to 30:11-30:14; larger 30:1-30:33 Agur parent
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Imperative morphology and consequence syntax make a complete saying, but its relation to adjacent sequences is not explicit.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The micro-unit remains under the exact 30:1-33 parent alternative and does not authorize social hierarchy or curse theology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: fourfold repeated-generation indictment catalogue
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Four successive dor clauses catalogue parental contempt, self-purity, pride and predation; the mouth/teeth image climaxes the series before a numbered leech saying.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: four separate sayings; 30:10-30:14; larger 30:1-30:33 Agur parent
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Exact repetition of dor at each opening is a strong Hebrew anaphoric binder; metaphorical teeth/knives do not demand literalization.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No generation-wide historical, class, purity or violence verdict is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: leech daughters and three-four insatiable things numerical saying

proposed_chunks.literary_form: filial-contempt warning with bird-of-prey consequence

proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: The subject-fronted eye and coordinated consequence imagery make one bicolon-like warning; accent and imagery remain evidence only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: three-four wonderful ways culminating in an adulterous-way comparison

proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_evidence: Four derekh phrases and the explanatory/comparative final verse bind the unit, though the exact force of almah and 'such is the way' is disputed.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: three-four earth-disturbing social reversals

proposed_chunks.literary_form: three-four stately walkers numerical saying
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A three/four formula lists lion, strutting creature, he-goat and king; repeated stately-movement language closes the list.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Lemuel superscription and maternal royal instruction
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The difficult superscription identifies words taught by a mother; repeated 'what, my son' appeal moves through women/intoxicants to commands for just speech, ending before the alphabetic poem.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: alphabetic poem praising a valiant/capable woman
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The aleph-to-tav line sequence governs the whole portrait; household, commerce, speech and fear-of-YHWH motifs culminate in public praise at the gates.

proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The poem does not authorize a universal gender role, socioeconomic model, authorship claim, theology or preferred translation.

hardest_zones: 1:20-1:33 and 8:1-8:36 because feminine personification, rare syntax and reception pressure can smuggle ontology into boundary work
10:1-22:16 and 25:1-29:27 because short sayings create overlapping parallelism and catchword networks without stable agreed macro-clusters
22:17-24:34 because explicit subcollection formulas coexist with instruction sequences and proposed ancient Near Eastern parallels
30:1-30:33 because superscription parsing, names, numerical rhetoric, rare creature terms and micro-unit context loss all remain live
31:1-31:31 because superscription translation pressure is followed by a formally strong but socially and theologically overread acrostic
reviewer_summary.larger_parent_policy: Where a smaller aphoristic or numerical cluster is disputed, retain the exact named collection or complete speech parent, lower confidence and queue qualified Hebrew/textual review.

textual critic for Qere/Ketiv, LXX ordering and plus/minus pressure
wisdom-form specialist for internal macro-clusters in 10:1-22:16 and 25:1-29:27
